verified: Not a Tesla App reported that Tesla's Dallas robotaxi service area grew 83% to 150 square miles, adding Carrollton, Addison and Richardson; EVwire's account of the same change describes the geofence moving from roughly 81 square miles north past I-635 toward Addison and Richardson.
unconfirmed: No Tesla statement, map or filing confirming the new boundary was cited by any of the reports, all of which repeat the same figures, so the 150-square-mile area, the roughly 81-square-mile starting point and the 83% figure rest on secondary reporting rather than company data; the reports also give no vehicle count, no detail on whether rides in the new zone are driverless, and no independent verification of service quality there.

verified: Not a Tesla App 与 EVwire 均报道，特斯拉将达拉斯 Robotaxi 服务区域扩大约 83%，从约 81 平方英里增至约 150 平方英里，并新增覆盖 Carrollton、Addison 和 Richardson，服务范围向北越过 I-635。两家媒体对新增面积和增幅的说法基本一致。
unconfirmed: 特斯拉官方没有发布扩区公告，也没有更新服务地图，上述地理范围目前仅来自媒体转述；约 81 平方英里的原面积基线只出现在 EVwire 于 X 的帖子中；报道未说明新增区域是否已全面开放叫车、投入车辆数量，以及是否以无安全员方式运营。

titles.en: Tesla expands Dallas robotaxi area 83% to 150 square miles
titles.zh: 特斯拉达拉斯 Robotaxi 服务区扩大 83% 至 150 平方英里
